walkthroughs.body_html:
Nanoparticles are 1-100 nm across.

They have a large surface area to volume ratio, so less material is needed for catalysis or sunscreens.

Risks: unknown long-term effects on health and environment.

C60 (bucky ball) is a cage molecule - used in drug delivery.

Nanotubes have high tensile strength and conduct electricity.

Both are simple molecular at the smallest scale but with unique properties.

Always link: structure -> bonds or forces broken -> property.

NaCl has a giant ionic lattice; strong electrostatic forces between ions need large energy to break, so mp is high.

Use the words delocalised, lattice, intermolecular precisely.

mcqs.q: Why are alloys harder than pure metals?
Which has the largest surface area to volume ratio?
Where is almost all the mass of an atom located?
options: In the nucleus, made up of protons and neutrons.
Mass is spread evenly throughout the entire atom including the electron shells.
Protons move from chlorine to sodium to balance the charges.
Electrons contribute significantly to the mass of an atom.

mcqs.q: What is different between two isotopes of the same element?
options: Isotopes are atoms of different elements with the same mass.
Isotopes have different numbers of electrons, which is why their mass differs.
They have the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons.
Mass is spread evenly throughout the entire atom including the electron shells.

mcqs.q: What happens to electrons when sodium reacts with chlorine?
options: Isotopes are atoms of different elements with the same mass.
Protons move from chlorine to sodium to balance the charges.
Sodium and chlorine share an electron between them.
Sodium loses one electron to chlorine; the resulting Na+ and Cl- ions attract electrostatically.
